title: Example app

scenes.name: intro
scenes.say: One sentence that says what the app is for.

scenes.name: search
scenes.say: Type part of a name and the list narrows straight away.

scenes.name: outro
scenes.say: Every job. Every run. In one place.

_notes: voice: a Kokoro voice name; leave it out for a random English one (tts.py --sample to hear them). speed: voice pace, default 1.0. breath: seconds of silence after each clip.

style (optional): accent = wordmark and tag colour, bg = card background (default: the page's own), font = a Google Fonts family, css = the tone's extra card CSS (grain, letterbox, glow). --accent/--bg/--font on recorder.py override it.
say: the voice-over for the scene; the scene holds for it. Cards stay at least 5 seconds.

card: headline (
for two lines), tags (up to three words, one centred line), subline (outro only, optional).
A hash change in an eval step is followed by a short automatic wait.

steps run in order at scene start: zoom {selector|null, pad px}, move/click selector, type {text}, key {key, vk, modifiers}, go path (SPA navigation), until js (hold till true), ff seconds + factor (fast-forward a wait), eval js, wait seconds. Any step may set its own timeout.
inject (optional): a JS file beside the scenes file, run on every page load: hide the person's name, define helpers such as a find-by-text tagger.
card.code: true sets the subline in monospace, for a command.
